claim: Model fitting steps, including trend fitting and variogram fitting, should be performed inside each validation fold when estimating predictive performance to avoid information leakage.
conditions: Applies when cross-validation is intended to estimate performance on unseen locations.
limitations: Full refitting is slower and can be unstable with small sample sizes; if skipped, the report must disclose possible optimism/leakage.
recommended_action: Keep CV_REFIT_VARIOGRAM enabled for scientific runs when computationally feasible.
not_allowed_action: Do not fit variogram using test points and present the result as strict out-of-sample validation.
